detail: collierappraiser.com robots.txt (User-agent: *) disallows /Main_Data/ where the bulk CSV downloads live, while COMPLIANCE.md 1.3 green-lists 'Collier Property Appraiser bulk CSV downloads' and sources.yaml has allow_automation:true verified:true. Specific sanction treated as controlling over the general robots courtesy rule; downloads executed one-at-a-time with descriptive UA via the site's own DataDownloads.html links (files are hosted on Google Drive behind a downloadgdfile.asp redirect). Note also robots.txt now blocks 'anthropic-ai'/'ClaudeBot' crawler UAs.
action_taken: Proceeded per green list; flagged for operator to confirm the interpretation and/or ask the appraiser office for a sanctioned pull path. Surface in next digest.

detail: robots.txt permissive (only /wp-admin/) and Terms of Use have no anti-scraping clause, but the actual listings page /california-listings/ is served behind an active JS bot-verification interstitial (wsidchk challenge with headless/webdriver detection). Solving or spoofing past it would be circumvention of a robot-exclusion mechanism; additionally the session's Chromium cannot complete TLS through the egress proxy (ERR_CONNECTION_RESET mid-handshake). Static pages (home, disclaimer, terms) fetch fine.
action_taken: MANUAL_CHECK emitted: operator to open https://clearrecon-ca.com/california-listings/ in a browser and pull LA/SF rows manually, or contact CRC for a data feed.

detail: Total Lender Solutions sale listings host serves the same wsidchk anti-bot JS challenge on every path including /robots.txt, so robots cannot even be read. Treated as automation-prohibited per COMPLIANCE 1.1 pattern (active bot protection). Main site totallendersolutions.com is fetchable (Crawl-Delay 20 honored) but carries no real-property listings (only UCC personal-property sales page).
action_taken: MANUAL_CHECK emitted: operator to browse https://tlssales.info/ for LA/SF trustee sales manually.

detail: Sales data sits behind account registration (portal sales.mccarthyholthus.com login/register); auto-registration prohibited by COMPLIANCE 1.2. Separately, egress proxy answers 502 CONNECT for qualityloan.com and sales.qualityloan.com (www.qualityloan.com is reachable). ToS is TermsFeed boilerplate with no anti-scraping clause.
action_taken: MANUAL_CHECK emitted: operator may register one human-held account and pull LA/SF sale rows manually.
